label: Turned Hegelian dialectic from idealist spirit right side up into historical materialism

Formulated and introduced Dialectical Historical Reason
Inverted Hegel's Absolute Idealism, insisting that material being precedes abstract consciousness
Zupančič mobilizes Hegelian contradiction and the concrete universal to articulate the structure of comedy and the ontological impasse of sexuality
